note: Every player of the 2006 MLB season with his score's inputs (npm run import:mlb-war; docs/design/baseball.md, "Seasons before 2018: computed from WAR"). Each player: [Baseball-Reference id, name, the name that tells him apart from a namesake of the season (else null), club (his last stint's), role (H, SP or RP), positions (the primary first), score, WAR of the season and the two before it (batting for a hitter, pitching for a pitcher; null where he did not play), plate appearances or innings of those seasons, average leverage index (relievers), Lahman birth country]. WAR: JEFFBAGWELL (Neil Paine, MIT), the average of Baseball-Reference's and FanGraphs' WAR. Names, birthplaces, clubs' records and ballparks: the Lahman Baseball Database 2025 (SABR, CC BY-SA 3.0). Each club: its name, league, won-lost record and the Lahman key of the ballpark it played most of its home games in.
